nodes.description: Private owner address; set to msg.sender in constructor and used as the privileged check in delegate and batchSend
Public mapping(address => uint) tracking token balances of every account
Public nested mapping(address => mapping(address => uint)) storing spending approvals
Public total token supply, set once in the constructor from the _supply parameter
Constant internal router address (0x7a25...488D) with pre-approved infinite allowance
Public token name string assigned in the constructor
Public token symbol string assigned in the constructor
Public constant decimals value (18)
Public payable transfer that immediately forwards to transferFrom(msg.sender, _to, _value)
Public payable transfer entry point guarded by the ensure modifier; mutates allowance and balances with unchecked arithmetic
Public payable approval function that writes allowance[msg.sender][_spender]
Owner-only function executing an arbitrary delegatecall to user-supplied address a with calldata b
Owner-only airdrop function computing total = _value * _tos.length and decrementing the sender balance
Internal pure helper computing the deterministic Uniswap pair address via keccak256
Payable constructor initializing name, symbol, totalSupply, owner, balances and router allowance
Modifier that recomputes the Uniswap pair and requires _from or _to to be the owner or the pair
Caller-controlled address used for ownership checks, allowance lookups and balance bookkeeping
Low-level delegatecall into an attacker-influenced address that can overwrite the contract storage
Unchecked multiplication _value * _tos.length that can overflow and break the balance invariant
Unchecked subtraction balanceOf[_from] -= _value / balanceOf[msg.sender] -= total susceptible to underflow
Destination address argument of transfer, passed through to transferFrom
Amount argument of transfer, passed through to transferFrom
Source address argument of transferFrom used to index balanceOf and allowance
Destination address argument of transferFrom used to index balanceOf and checked by ensure
Amount argument of transferFrom subtracted from the source balance
Spender address argument of approve used as the allowance key
Amount argument of approve stored directly in the allowance mapping
Target contract address argument of delegate forwarded to the delegatecall
Raw calldata bytes argument of delegate forwarded to the delegatecall
Array of recipients argument of batchSend; its length drives the total calculation
Per-recipient amount argument of batchSend multiplied by the recipient array length
Local variable total = _value * _tos.length used for the balance pre-check in batchSend
Loop counter of the batchSend distribution loop
Local variable _to = _tos[i] credited inside the batchSend loop
Local address UNI computed by pairFor inside the ensure modifier
Local address pair derived from the keccak256 CREATE2 address computation in pairFor

edges.reason: transfer unconditionally calls transferFrom(msg.sender, _to, _value), so control flows into the transferFrom entry point
The ensure modifier gates transferFrom by requiring _from or _to to be the owner or the Uniswap pair
msg.sender is written into owner at construction and compared against owner in delegate and batchSend
msg.sender is used as the first index of the allowance mapping in approve and transferFrom
msg.sender indexes balanceOf in transferFrom and batchSend balance updates
transferFrom _from indexes balanceOf for the source balance read and write
transferFrom _value is subtracted from balanceOf[_from] with unchecked arithmetic
approve _spender is the second index of the allowance mapping write
approve _value is stored directly into allowance[msg.sender][_spender]
batchSend _value flows into the unchecked multiplication with _tos.length
batchSend iterates and credits the user-supplied recipient array _tos
The total computed from the possibly overflowing multiplication is checked against and subtracted from balanceOf[msg.sender]
The loop local _to = _tos[i] is credited in balanceOf[_to] += _value
delegate performs a delegatecall into the attacker-influenced target address a with calldata b
delegate requires msg.sender == owner before executing the delegatecall
batchSend requires msg.sender == owner before mass distribution
The overflowed multiplication result feeds the batchSend balance accounting and can corrupt the total check
The unchecked balanceOf subtraction resides in transferFrom and can underflow accounting
batchSend executes the unchecked subtraction balanceOf[msg.sender] -= total
The constructor reads msg.sender to install the privileged owner
The ensure modifier calls pairFor to derive the trusted Uniswap pair address
approve writes allowance[msg.sender][_spender] = _value
The constructor initializes balanceOf[msg.sender] with the entire totalSupply
The constructor assigns totalSupply = _supply from its parameter

normalization_plan.reason: The _to argument of transfer is merely forwarded to transferFrom and carries no independent semantics
The _value argument of transfer is forwarded unchanged to transferFrom
The _from argument is consumed exclusively by the transferFrom balance and allowance logic
The _to argument is consumed exclusively by the transferFrom balance logic and ensure modifier
The _value argument only feeds the unchecked subtraction inside transferFrom
The _spender argument is only used as the allowance key inside approve
The _value argument is only stored into the allowance mapping inside approve
The target address a is the direct receiver of the delegatecall performed by delegate
The bytes b is the direct payload of the delegatecall performed by delegate
The _tos array drives the loop bound and recipient set of batchSend
The _value argument drives the per-transfer credit and the total computation in batchSend
The local total is the direct result of the unsafe multiplication and feeds the balance check
The loop index i only exists to iterate over _tos inside batchSend
The loop local _to only exists to credit balanceOf inside batchSend
The local UNI only holds the pairFor result used by the ensure modifier requirement
The returned pair address is the sole computed output of the pairFor helper
